topic: The Transformational View of Derivatives: From Slopes to Dynamic Rates

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Static Slope
lecture_lines: Constant speed means a constant slope.
Rise over run gives the steepness.
animations: Create a static CoordinateSystem. Add a straight line representing y = mx. Color: #FFFFFF.
Draw a Δy segment vertically and a Δx segment horizontally. Color: #FF00FF. Label them 'Δy' and 'Δx'.
Animate a small dot moving along the line with constant speed. Color: #00FF00.

sections.title: The Problem of Curvature
animations: Draw a curved function y = f(x). Color: #FFFFFF.
Place a dot at a starting position on the curve. Move it; observe the changing slope direction. Color: #FF6600.
Flash a question mark at a specific steep point on the curve. Label the point 'P'. Color: #FF0000.

sections.title: The Zooming Transformation (Secant to Tangent)
animations: Draw a curve with two points P and Q connected by a secant line. Color P and Q as #FF0000. Secant line: #FFFFFF.
Animate Q moving closer along the curve towards P. Show the Δx segment shrinking.
As Q approaches P, change the secant line color to #00FFFF representing the tangent as it emerges.
Zoom the camera view on P, showing the curve flattening locally into the tangent line.
Finalize with the tangent line displayed clearly at point P. Label: 'Tangent'. Color: #00FFFF.

sections.title: Defining the Derivative as an Operator
animations: Draw a box labeled 'f(x)' on the left and 'f'(x)' on the right. Color: #FFFFFF.
Animate the curve f(x) entering the box and the derived slope function f'(x) exiting the box. Color: #FF9900 for f(x), #00FF00 for f'(x).
Show a small graph window beneath, plotting the value of f'(x) as a dot moving across the screen. Color: #00FF00.
Display the transformation notation: 'd/dx [f(x)] = f'(x)'. Color: #FFFF00. Flash it.
Show the machine mapping multiple points: indicate inputs and their corresponding output slopes. Color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Synthesis: Dynamic Interpretation
animations: Show a graph of rocket position over time: 's(t)'. Color: #FFFFFF.
Draw the velocity curve derived from position: 'v(t)'. Color: #FF00FF. Label 'Derivative = Velocity'.
Animate a rocket symbol moving up the y-axis while the velocity graph builds simultaneously. Color: #FF6600.
